answer: Terraced vesting: each new agent's rewards unlock in steps, one terrace per ten epochs of honest work, and anything still locked is forfeited if the agent is caught colluding. A sybil farmer's whole grove of fake identities must each grind through the same slow climb, so spawning clones buys nothing up front. Graders flag clusters that answer in lockstep, burning all of their locked coins at once. Over a long horizon, cheating costs more than honest mining pays.
